summary.result: BMPs have been expected to result in water quality improvements in rural areas in addition to functioning in soil and water conservation and erosion control capacities.
summary.background: Best management practices (BMPs) have been applied for erosion control and soil conservation worldwide for many years.
summary.method: In this paper, the physical characteristics and functions of several frequently applied BMPs are reviewed.
